entities.name: Millicent
entities.description: Geist soldier from Innistrad; in life mayor and captain of the guard of a small township in Stensia, now leading spirits seeking vengeance.

entities.name: Cyril Rav
entities.description: Necro-alchemist who created the geistbomb and experimented on geists.

entities.name: Eloise Wicker
entities.description: Employed by Millicent to find Rav and Hauken.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: Events that left many vengeful spirits on Innistrad.

events.summary: Millicent's town is wiped off the map by a geistbomb created by Cyril Rav.
events.quote: The town was wiped off the map by a geistbomb created by the necro-alchemist Cyril Rav.

events.summary: Millicent and her citizens rise again as spirits, traveling the plane seeking vengeance.
events.quote: Millicent and her citizens rose again as spirits

events.summary: Misused in Rav's experiments, Millicent employs Eloise Wicker to find Rav and Jacob Hauken.
events.quote: She employed Eloise Wicker to find Rav and his accomplice Jacob Hauken .

relations.quote: The town was wiped off the map by a geistbomb created by the necro-alchemist Cyril Rav.
